title: One woven curtain for the arrival and every route
summary: A fixed grid of cells rebuilt to the viewport (about 72 × 75 CSS px, 20 × 12 on a desktop, 5 × 11 on a phone), each scaling on X from a hairline to a solid bar in `0.4 s power3.inOut`, swept from the bottom-right cell `0.02 s` apart by grid distance; shut from first paint; the arrival gate waits for fonts and image decodes, at least 0.9 s (0.25 s on a repeat visit) and never past a 4 s ceiling; routes swap only behind a fully shut curtain, save the scroll on leaving and restore it on back and forward only, move focus to the new `h1`, set the title and announce the page; a 0.2 s fade under reduced motion; a stylesheet in `<noscript>` drops the curtain without script
variants: Hash routes in one document (this, default)
As the cover of a transition library: call cover() in leave and uncover() in enter (Barba, Taxi: page-transitions)
Cells in the ground of the incoming page, so the page weaves into its next theme
